examples.title: Edit profile
examples.description: A modal dialog with a form: focus moves into it, Tab stays inside, Escape or Close closes it and focus returns to the trigger.

examples.title: Tabs
examples.description: Tabs with a roving tab stop: the arrows move between tabs, Home and End reach the ends, and each tab shows its panel.

examples.title: Select
examples.description: A select that opens on click or the keyboard, types ahead while closed, and returns focus to its trigger.
